--ds-table-row-hover.description: the row hover layer on the cells; a fixed colour where `color-mix(currentColor)` misbehaves

--ds-table-row-selected.description: a selected table row (`.ds-table__row--selected`, a checked checkbox in a cell)

--ds-table-head-height.description: table header cells (the block padding follows)

--ds-table-row-height.description: table body cells (the block padding follows)

--ds-table-sticky-bg.description: the opaque base of the sticky header and the pinned column, and the background of `.ds-table-wrap--fill`

--ds-table-cell-max-width.description: where a cell of `.ds-table-wrap--fill` is cut with an ellipsis

--ds-table-fill-min-height.description: the least height of `.ds-table-wrap--fill` (a short window scrolls the view instead)
